description: v1.6 pulse (counts only, every plan): pulse.posted lists picks posted per UTC hour for the last 193 hours ({hour, picks}) and pulse.settled picks settled per UTC hour for the last 49 hours ({hour, wins, losses, pushes, profitUnits}); empty hours are left out. Use it to say how many picks the Desk posted today, how today went, and when picks usually land, in the customer’s own time zone, when the Queue is empty. v1.5 Kalshi: a Kalshi pick’s link opens Kalshi’s board for the game (linkKind "game") and linkMarket names the one Kalshi market that is the bet and the side to buy: {ticker, side ("yes" | "no"), title (Kalshi’s own wording)}; linkMarket is null at every other book. v1.4 links: each pick’s link is the book’s own link rebuilt for the customer’s state, with linkKind ("bet" = the book opens with the bet in the slip, "game" = on the game’s page, null = no link) and linkNeedsState (true when the book has per-state sites only and the customer’s state is unknown); rules.bookLinks lists every book with opens ("bet" | "game" | null), needsState, and for Desk plan picks, betLinks, gameLinks on this answer. v1.3: each pick also carries fairPct (the Desk’s one fair chance for the bet) and evidence (the biggest thing that moved its Grade: line, top {what, direction, points, sourceName, sourceUrl, quote}) and contextLine (when nothing moved the Grade but it holds a quoted sentence code could not size for the bet, such as team news on a game total: that sentence with its source and link; null otherwise); the answer also holds arbitrage (sure-win pairs, see get_desk_arbitrage; optional total = dollars to split) and expired (picks whose edge is gone, see get_desk_expired). The Desk tab as the app reads it (GET desk). picks: the open Desk picks whose real Grade is B or better (B, B+, A-, A, A+), each with label, matchup, book, price, edge, paper stake in units, bet link and grade {letter, score, jobId, report: true}; picks with no Grade yet or a lower Grade are not on the Desk. Optional placed: pick ids the customer placed, returned as bets (open or settled) with their Grade whatever its letter. record: every settled Desk pick (totals, with beatClosePct over every pick whose closing line is final and settledBeatClosePct over settled picks only; history: the newest 500 settled picks with the running units; byDay: every Eastern day since the start with that day’s settled count, won-lost, units, running units and beat-the-close share). The Desk plan and up get the picks (a Pro subscription that was paying when the Desk plan began keeps it while that subscription stays active); Free, Starter and Pro get locked rows (league and start time only), the same count, and the record. Reads only; nothing is placed.

total.description: Dollars to split across the two bets of each arbitrage pair (default 100).
